sections.title: 1. General Information and Mandatory Notices
sections.content: Protecting your personal data is important to us. We treat your personal information confidentially and in accordance with legal data protection regulations as well as this privacy policy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have regarding your data.

sections.title: 2. Responsible Party for Data Processing
sections.content: The responsible party for data processing within this web app is: [Operator's Name] [Address] [Email Address] [Phone Number]

sections.title: 3. Collection and Storage of Personal Data
4. Use of Data for Wishlist Management
sections.content: Each wishlist belongs to exactly one person. It is private at first and visible only to the person it belongs to. Once it is shared, exactly the people who have been entered on it can see that list and the ideas on it. Those people may mark an idea as bought; they cannot add, change or delete entries. Product links and ideas are stored in our database.

sections.title: 5. Premium Model and Payment Data
sections.content: If you choose our premium model, additional information necessary for payment processing will be stored. This includes: Payment methods, Transaction data, Payment status. Payment data is used exclusively for processing the premium membership and is securely stored in our database.

sections.title: 6. Data Sharing and Transfer
sections.content: We only share your personal data if it is necessary for fulfilling our service or if we are legally required to do so. No data is transferred to third parties without your explicit consent.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy or as legally required. Data is typically deleted after the end of the contractual relationship and upon completion of statutory retention periods.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right at any time to: Request information about the data we have stored about you, Request correction of incorrect data, Request restriction of processing, Request deletion of your data, as permitted by law, Object to the processing of your data. To exercise your rights or if you have any further questions regarding the processing of your personal data, please contact us at: jsbase.dev@gmail.com.

sections.title: 9. Data Security
sections.content: We employ appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or manipulation. Our security measures are continuously improved in line with technological advancements.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy to comply with changes in legal requirements or in the functionality of our web app. The current version of the privacy policy is available on our web app at any time.

subsections.title: a) When Visiting Our Web App
subsections.content: When you access our web app, certain data is automatically collected by our server, such as: IP address, Date and time of access, Browser and operating system used, Pages visited and actions within the web app. This data is used exclusively to ensure smooth operation and improve our web app, and is automatically deleted afterward.

subsections.title: b) Registration and Login for Using the Web App
subsections.content: To use the web app, an account with an email address, a password and a display name is required. During registration and login, we store: account data (email address, password and display name), your own wishlists with their gift ideas and links to products, and on shared lists the email address and display name of the people it is shared with. The password is hashed before it is stored and cannot be recovered in plain text. For every idea marked as bought we also store the account that marked it. The mark belongs to everyone the list is shared with: they can correct each other's marks. Only the person who owns the list is unable to remove a mark somebody else set; the name is never shown in the web app.

sections.title: 1. Scope
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions apply to the use of the wishy web app, a platform for organizing gifts between individual people.

sections.title: 2. Service Description
sections.content: wishy enables users to organize gift wishes, create wishlists, and keep track of planned gifts. The app serves to coordinate gifts between the people who share a list, while maintaining the element of surprise.

sections.title: 3. Registration and User Account
sections.content: Using wishy requires creating an account of your own with an email address and a password. Users are obligated to keep their access credentials confidential and protect them from third-party access.

sections.title: 4. Usage Rules
sections.content: Users agree to use the app only for its intended purpose and not to share any illegal or offensive content.

sections.title: 5. Privacy
sections.content: The protection of personal data is our highest priority. Details can be found in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 6. Disclaimer
sections.content: wishy does not guarantee constant availability of the app and is not liable for damages caused by slight negligence.
